facts.value: 1865, London, as the Christian Mission. Named Salvation Army 1878-1880

citations.excerpt: SALVATION ARMY, a religious philanthropic organization founded by William Booth ( q.v. ), who in 1865 began to hold meetings for preaching in the streets in London
In 1878 the Mission, which had spread beyond London, was reorganized on a quasi-military basis, and the title of “The Salvation Army” was definitely adopted in June 1880.
Booth was assisted by his Wife, Catherine Booth

facts.value: An organization best known for its social work and military-style organization. It is also a Holiness denomination.

citations.excerpt: Though best known for its social work and its military organization, it is also a Holiness denomination.
